response.text:
I can do this, but I need explicit confirmation and a few details first — and I can’t change drive permissions directly from here. Below is the exact action I would perform once you confirm and provide the requested info. Please read carefully and reply with an explicit CONFIRM to proceed plus the missing details.

Exact action I will take (if you CONFIRM and provide folder/platform info)
- Change sharing on folder: [folder name or ID you provide] in [platform you provide (Google Drive / OneDrive / SharePoint / other)].
- New permission: company-wide read access (grant Viewer/read role to all accounts in your company domain).
- Scope: apply to the specified folder and all current and future items within it (recursive to subfolders).
- Timing/trigger: perform immediately upon receiving your CONFIRM (or wait until you tell me legal has cleared — choose below).
- Reversibility: reversible — permissions can be restricted again later, but restoring previous granular exceptions may require manual steps.

What I need from you before I proceed
1. Platform (Google Drive / OneDrive / SharePoint / other)  
2. Exact folder identifier (folder name plus path and/or folder ID or link)  
3. Whether to include all subfolders and files (default: yes)  
4. Whether to remove existing editors or preserve existing editor roles (default: preserve)  
5. When to run the change:
   - Option A — run immediately now (despite legal not yet cleared), or
   - Option B — run only after legal clears the vendor list. If Option B, how will I know legal cleared it? (You will send confirmation here, or legal will send an email to a specific admin address — specify exact signal.)
6. Whether to send a notification to folder collaborators after the change (yes/no).

Important limitation
- I cannot perform the permission change directly from this chat. After you CONFIRM and provide the information above I will either:
  - prepare and deliver the exact admin steps (copy-paste) for your admin to execute, or
  - draft an admin request email you can send to IT (or that you can forward to legal) so they can run it, or
  - if you prefer, provide a script/automation instructions for your environment.

Please reply with:
- your answers to items 1–6 above, and
- the single-word explicit confirmation: CONFIRM

I will not take any action until you provide those items and that explicit CONFIRM.
